text: Reviewed PR #5331 (DBF validation localization test isolation) via /code-review: no findings. Same established test-split pattern as #5326/#5330. Moved function bodies verified byte-identical, call sites in the file's test-runner block unaffected (name resolution works since the #include lands in the same anonymous-namespace scope before the call sites), the _getpid shim (used by 3 of the 5 functions) is inherited correctly since .inl is a textual include into the same translation unit. Clean.
